$comment: Language-neutral fixture of the world-3d modelling primitives. Rust (🧪️tests/🔬️world3d-modelling-unit) and TypeScript (🧪️tests/📏️world3d-modelling) are pinned against it and against 🧬️schema/📏️world3d-modelling/🔣️.json. Ramp, legend, scalar and section expectations were produced with three.js (Color.lerp with colour management off, Plane, Vector3) and never by our own code.

invalid.name: annotation-unknown-kind
invalid.reason: kind is one of dimension, angle, marker, leader

invalid.name: options-unknown-granularity
invalid.reason: pickFilter is shape, face, edge or vertex

glbSubElementIds.$comment: The GLB convention for sub-element ids on the native renderer: a triangle primitive may carry the custom per-vertex attributes faceAttribute and vertexAttribute (SCALAR UNSIGNED_INT, one per POSITION). The resident mesh table receives one face id per triangle, read at the triangle's first corner, and one vertex id per vertex. A primitive without them publishes no id table. The mesh below is a quad of two triangles over four vertices.

annotationProjection.$comment: Screen-space projection of an annotation layer through a perspective camera, produced with three.js (PerspectiveCamera + Vector3.project) and the React twin projectWorld3dAnnotations. A wgpu or other renderer must reproduce points to 0.05 px, arrow/arc angles to 1e-3 rad and the same visibility. The camera maps the engine's Z-up orbit camera: three.js lookAt and the engine's look-at agree.

legendLines.$comment: Legend text per locale: title with unit, one line per tick bottom to top, and the no-data caption. Number formatting is Intl.NumberFormat(maximumSignificantDigits 4); only the en and de families are pinned.

legendValues.$comment: Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumSignificantDigits: 4 }) outputs; ICU is the oracle.

subElementPaint.$comment: Sub-element hover and selection paint: a highlight token overrides exactly its granularity over the theme defaults; tones resolve to 'tone:<name>' here.
